name: PowerConneX III gas supply pipeline

values.RouteNotes: The Energy Cooperative publishes an approximate interactive map only. Phase 1 runs along Rt. 161 from Mink Street near New Albany to near Granville. Phase 2 runs from Granville to near Hebron along Rt. 40 and is still being aligned.
values.DataCenterNotes: The data center is the EdgeConneX campus in New Albany, Licking County, Ohio. EdgeConneX bought 270 acres from VanTrust Real Estate for 137.2 million dollars. Phase 1 converts a 524,525 square foot warehouse and Phase 2 adds a 700,000 square foot data center. The campus is off-grid and powered by PowerConneX gas plants owned by an EdgeConneX affiliate. PowerConneX I is 120 MW and PowerConneX II is 216 MW, both under construction, and a third plant of 430 MW is in the pre-application stage. The Energy Cooperative of Newark is building the 24-mile line, and PowerConneX is paying about 160 million dollars for it. A Reporting Project article from July 2026 ties the line to the 216 MW plant. A Farm and Dairy article from June 2026 says the 430 MW plant would need a new 24-mile, 24-inch line. No tenant is named in the sources read. Phase 1 of the line is due in September 2027 and Phase 2 in 2028.

researcher_notes: This is a new pipeline with no row in the database. The Energy Cooperative of Newark, Ohio, a member-owned gas utility, is proposing a 24-mile, 24-inch steel line in Licking County. The utility's own project page says it would serve a behind-the-meter power plant for an off-grid data center and lists Ohio Power Siting Board case 26-769-GA-BLN. A local news report from late July 2026 says EdgeConneX's PowerConneX is paying for the roughly 160 million dollar line and names the New Albany data center. An earlier March 2026 report gave 150 million dollars. I used the later figure. Phase 1 runs from near Granville to the plant in New Albany and is scheduled for completion in September 2027. Phase 2 runs from Granville to near Hebron to reach a large transmission pipeline and is scheduled for 2028. Most Phase 1 easements are secured. A June 2026 Farm and Dairy report says the proposed 430 MW PowerConneX III plant would need a new 24-mile, 24-inch pipeline, which matches this line. The July report ties the line to the 216 MW PowerConneX II plant, so the plant it serves is not fully settled. The alias PowerConneX III gas supply pipeline comes only from the Farm and Dairy page, which describes the line but does not use that exact name. It may be a different pipeline, so treat the alias as tentative. Capacity was not found. Start and end points are approximate. No downloadable route was found. The owner spelling was not matched to the ownership team gazetteer, so the name is kept as the sources state it. Confidence is high for existence, sponsor, length, diameter and data center tie, and medium for cost and dates. The OPSB docket page was not read.
